scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm --workspace @raceoffice/frontend run build
scripts.build:packages: npm run build:domain && npm --workspace @raceoffice/p3parser run build && npm --workspace @raceoffice/rmonitor run build && npm --workspace @raceoffice/race-status-mock run build && npm --workspace @raceoffice/test-utils run build
scripts.mock:race-status: npm run build:domain && npm --workspace @raceoffice/race-status-mock run build && node packages/race-status-mock/dist/cli/raceStatusMock.js
scripts.record:race-status: npm run build:domain && npm --workspace @raceoffice/race-status-mock run build && node packages/race-status-mock/dist/cli/recordRaceStatus.js
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:all && npm run build:all
scripts.test:all: npm run build:packages && npm run test:run --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:server && npm run build:livetracking-worker && npm run build:livetracking-frontend && npm run build:p3test-frontend && npm run build:leaderboard-service
scripts.build:leaderboard-service: npm --workspace @raceoffice/leaderboard-frontend run build && npm --workspace @raceoffice/leaderboard-service run build
scripts.bundle:leaderboard-service: npm run build:leaderboard-service && npm --workspace @raceoffice/leaderboard-service run bundle
scripts.dev:all: concurrently --names "server,frontend,livetracking,p3test" --prefix-colors "blue,green,cyan,yellow" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev" "npm run dev:livetracking-frontend" "npm run dev:p3test-frontend"
